name: The All-New Popeye Hour
description: The All-New Popeye Hour is an animated television series produced by Hanna-Barbera Productions and King Features Syndicate. Starring the popular comic strip character Popeye, the series aired from 1978 to 1983 on CBS.

videos.title: The Popeye Valentine Special: Sweethearts at Sea
videos.overview: When Popeye forgets to send Olive Oyl a valentine, she takes a Valentine's Day Sweetheart Cruise, convinced that she'll find her "Mr. Right" there.

videos.title: Popeye The Carpenter
videos.overview: Olive is trying to hang a picture, but knocks a hole in the wall. She hollers for Popeye to come and help, but Bluto tags along. Soon, the whole house is destroyed. Popeye rebuilds the house in the end, but when he tries to hang the picture again, the house comes crumbling down.

videos.title: The Ski's the Limit
videos.overview: Olive Oyl is teaching Swee'Pea how to skate. Popeye tries to learn also, but falls. Meanwhile, Swee'Pea is in danger, and Olive tries to rescue him, but in vain. Popeye goes to their rescue and saves them both.

videos.title: To Boo Or Not To Boo
Popeye Goes Sailing
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive are going on an outing on Popeye's sailboat. Bluto, who's ever-trying to force his affections on Olive, sinks Popeye's boat and takes Olive aboard his own sailboat. Popeye, in the meantime, has been swallowed by a whale. When Popeye hears Olive's cry for help, he eats his spinach and takes care of business (as usual).

videos.title: The Umpire Strikes Back
videos.overview: Duplicate of S02E42

videos.title: A Day at the Muscle Beach
The Lonliness of the Long Distance Popeye
Popeye The Plumber
videos.overview: Olive has a leak in her plumbing. She calls Popeye the plumber to come and fix it. Popeye tries to fix the leak, but Swee'Pea keeps turning the water meter on and off to confuse the situation. Before he manages to fix the faucet, Popeye makes a shambles out of Olive's house.

videos.title: A Horse of a Flying Color
Close Encounters of the Third Spinach
I Left My Spinach in San Francisco
Ship Ahoy
videos.overview: Popeye takes his nephews to the high seas to teach them about sailing a boat. Bluto has other ideas and tries to ruin their day, only to learn a lesson of his own, thanks to Popeye and his little heroes.

videos.title: Popeye at the Center of the Earth
Hail, Hail The Gangs All Here
Popeye Goes Sightseeing
videos.overview: Popeye, Olive and Swee'Pea are sightseeing in New York City. Olive visits a department store to try on some dresses, leaving Popeye to watch Swee'Pea. However, Swee'Pea decides to do some sightseeing of his own, and when Popeye's back is turned, he wanders off. Popeye realizes that Swee'Pea is gone and decides to go get him before Olive learns that he is missing. Swee'Pea leads Popeye on a merry chase through New York, including the subway and the World Trade Center, ending up on the Statue of Liberty, where Popeye has to eat some spinach to save him when he falls off. Popeye returns with Swee'Pea in the nick of time before Olive realizes that they are gone. When he finally catches Swee'Pea, Popeye is so exhausted that he wants to take a nap, but then Olive wants to go sightseeing, and she can't understand why Popeye's so tired.

videos.title: Mother Goose is on the Loose
Steeple Chase at Ups and Downs
Take Me Out to the Brawl Game
Queen of the Load
videos.overview: Popeye, Olive and Bluto are all truckers out on the road cross-country in their own little convoy (with CB radios and everything). Popeye and Olive Oyl are partners driving the same truck. Bluto thinks that he would do much better with his trucking business if he had Olive as a partner, so he tries to talk her into it. When she refuses, Bluto makes all kinds of difficulties for her while she's on the road, but Popeye comes to her rescue and saves the day.

videos.title: Love on the Rocks
videos.overview: Olive doesn't think that Popeye is romantic enough, so Popeye decides to build a monument dedicated to the both of them: he carves their pictures on a mountain. The ever-troublemaking Bluto also wants to impress Olive, and he starts to interfere with Popeye's work. He decides to carve his picture over Popeye's, and the battle is on. Popeye gets so mad that he throws Bluto into a pool. Before you know it, the whole mountain is gone. Olive then decides it doesn't matter if the world doesn't know that Popeye cares for her as long as she does.

videos.title: Popeye the Lone Legionnaire
videos.overview: Popeye is the last legionnaire manning the last outpost in the Sahara. Bluto is a desert pirate bent on taking the fort from Popeye. Olive Oyl is, of course, the damsel in distress. Bluto captures the fort, raising the Jolly Roger flag. He captures Olive. Popeye comes to her rescue, and they both work to defeat Bluto. Popeye and Olive live happily ever after at the outpost.

videos.title: Roller Rink-a-Dink
videos.overview: Olive goes roller skating and takes Popeye along with her. While Popeye is trying to skate, Bluto tries to move in and take Olive away from Popeye.

videos.title: Old McPopeye Had a Farm
videos.overview: Popeye's Uncle Angus McPopeye has asked for his help because Farmer Bluto is stealing everything from his farm.

videos.title: Chips Off The Old Ice Block
videos.overview: Popeye and Bluto get into an argument over who will teach Swee'Pea to skate. Bluto makes Swee'Pea try a barrel-jumping trick, and Popeye must save him from going over the edge of a cliff. Thanks to Popeye and his spinach, Swee'Pea is saved.

videos.title: Polly Wants Some Spinach
videos.overview: While Olive is spring cleaning one day, her parrot Polly accidentally escapes. Olive immediately calls for Popeye to help her. Of course, he's followed by Bluto, who also wants to help. Popeye and Bluto pursue the bird as well as each other, and when Popeye finally manages to get rid of Bluto and catch the bird, he discovers that it's the wrong parrot. Polly had returned home by herself.

videos.title: Popeye's High School Daze
videos.overview: Olive and Popeye are looking at some pictures from their yearbook. Popeye starts to reminisce about some episodes between Bluto and himself, only to realize that Olive has fallen asleep.

videos.title: Mule-itary Detail
videos.overview: Driving in the country, Popeye and Olive find a stray army mule.

videos.title: Building Blockheads
videos.overview: Construction workers Popeye and Olive are building what they hope will be the world's tallest building.

videos.title: Olive's Bugged House Blues
videos.overview: Olive has a brand new home, so Popeye and Bluto bring housewarming presents.

videos.title: Boo-Who
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive are exploring a deserted island when a storm comes up at night.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: After a short stint at sea, Popeye and Olive get blown ashore by a storm.

videos.title: Popeye The Robot
videos.overview: It's National Popeye Day, but Bluto plans to ruin the day by letting loose a robot Popeye!

videos.title: Wotsa Matterhorn
videos.overview: Popeye and Bluto enter a race to see who will be the first to climb the Matterhorn and blow the legendary "Matterhorn Flueglehorn."

videos.title: Pedal-Powered-Popeye
videos.overview: Olive has entered the Cross-Country Bike Race and invites Popeye to join in, which he does. However, Bluto also has plans to enter.

videos.title: Popeye's Aqua Circus
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive are putting on an "aqua-circus" featuring trained seals and dolphins and other sea creatures. However, Bluto is jealous and wants to take over.

videos.title: Take It or Lump It
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive are contestants on the popular game show "Take It Or Lump It." Bluto disposes of the MC and takes his place.

videos.title: Popeye's Poodle Problem
videos.overview: Olive has just acquired a new French poodle called Frenchy. She asks Popeye to take him to the dog show for her.

videos.title: Westward Ho! Ho!
videos.overview: Popeye tells his nephews a wild and fanciful story about how he dug the Grand Canyon single-handedly.

videos.title: Bad Day at the Bakery
videos.overview: Olive opens up a bakery on a street filled with potholes. Popeye and Bluto volunteer to help out, but they don't get much done because of their fighting.

videos.title: Popeye the Painter
videos.overview: Popeye and Bluto are hired to do some building painting by a toy company who tells them that whoever finishes their designated job first wins a big contract.

videos.title: Bully Dozer
videos.overview: Olive portrays a beautiful princess who lies fast asleep because of a witch's curse.

videos.title: Swee'Pea Plagues A Parade
videos.overview: Swee'Pea is entered in a parade as a "strong man." However, he causes havoc and worry for Popeye and Olive when he wanders off to chase a balloon.

videos.title: Paddle Wheel Popeye
videos.overview: Popeye and Bluto are in a boat race to New Orleans on the Mississippi River.

videos.title: Merry Madness at the Mardi Gras
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive try to decide what costumes to wear for the Mardi Gras.

videos.title: Popeye of Sherwood Forest
videos.overview: Bluto is the evil Sheriff of Rottenham who collects heavy taxes from the poor peasants of Sherwood Forest.

videos.title: Bad Company
videos.overview: Popeye's nephews, Pipeye, Pupeye and Poopeye, decide to go to the Annual Sailors' Picnic with "Uncle Bluto" instead of Uncle Popeye and Auntie Olive.

videos.title: Top Kick in Boot Camp
videos.overview: Private Olive Oyl enters boot camp, and the Captain assigns Sergeant Bluto and Corporal Popeye to conduct her physical training courses.

videos.title: Peask & Quiet
videos.overview: Popeye's mischievous nephews are getting on his nerves, so Olive suggests that he take Eugene the Jeep with him to the mountains and stay at her uncle's little cabin for some peace and quiet.

videos.title: A Goon Gone Gooney
videos.overview: Popeye, Olive Oyl and Bluto are out for a sail when they are caught in a giant tidal wave and wash up on Goon Island.

videos.title: Spa-ing Partners
videos.overview: Olive has opened a health spa, and both Popeye and Bluto are applying for the job of exercise instructor.

videos.title: Abject Flying Object
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive befriend a little alien who's landed his spaceship in Olive's back yard. Bluto arrives on the scene and tries to capture the little spaceman so that he can take him on talk shows and become rich and famous as his agent. This time, however, the little spaceman eats some spinach, wallops Bluto and leaves for his planet, promising Popeye and Olive a return visit.

videos.title: Ships That Pass in the Fright
videos.overview: Once again, Popeye and Olive find themselves shipwrecked on a deserted island. When Bluto shows up to save them, trouble begins for Popeye.

videos.title: Popeye's Self Defense
videos.overview: At Olive's insistence, Popeye decides to take an exercise class at a new gym so that he can be strong without spinach, only to discover that Bluto just happens to be the instructor.

videos.title: Popeye's Perilous Pursuit of a Pearl
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive are on an expedition in search of the Black Pearl of Wacky Wahoo. The Sea Hag also wants the Black Pearl because of its magical powers.

videos.title: Olive Goes Dallas
videos.overview: While attending a Dallas football game, Olive finds out about a contest to become a member of the Dallas Cheerleaders.

videos.title: Pappy Falls in Love
videos.overview: While aboard a cruise ship, Pappy tries his best to woo a "young" lady with whom he has fallen in love.

videos.title: Popeye of the Jungle
videos.overview: Popeye tells Swee'Pea a bedtime story about his heroic great-great-uncle, Popeye of the Jungle.

videos.title: Alpine For You
videos.overview: Popeye, Olive and Bluto live in the Alps. Olive even tries to yodel, much to Popeye and Bluto's chagrin.

videos.title: Tour Each His Own
videos.overview: Popeye and Bluto are each in the "tour guide business" and not doing very well.

videos.title: The Umpire Strikes Back
videos.overview: At the bottom of the ninth, the home team (consisting of Popeye, Olive and Swee'Pea) is down 49-0 against Bluto's team.

videos.title: Free Hauling Brawl
videos.overview: The Eight Ball Trucking Company has a job open for a driver - and it goes to the winner of a cross-country truck race between Popeye and Bluto.

videos.title: W.O.I.L.
videos.overview: Olive and Popeye are running radio station W.O.I.L. (Olive is the DJ and Popeye is the helicopter traffic reporter), and Bluto is running their rival station.

videos.title: Tough Sledding
videos.overview: Granny Oyl's winter ski resort is in trouble, and she may have to go out of business, while rival Bluto's resort is doing very well.

videos.title: Unidentified Fighting Object
videos.overview: Popeye and Olive are having a backyard cookout. Popeye's nephews are playing basketball, and their ball goes over the fence into Bluto's yard.

videos.title: I Wouldn't Take That Mare To The Fair On A Dare
videos.overview: Popeye and the gang are at a county fair. Olive and Bluto have their horses entered in the "strong horse" contest, with Wimpy as judge. Swee'Pea wants to enter his horse, an old mare, also, but nobody takes him seriously. In order for the horses to win, the horse has to drag a sledge of rocks weighing 50,000 tons. The contest begins. The cheater Bluto, up to his old tricks, puts a picture of Mare-A-lin, the "Filly Fatale," in his horse's blinders. Bluto's horse takes off like a bird in flight, and Wimpy never gets to say "go." Bluto's horse is disqualified. It's now Olive's turn, and Bluto gets jealous and plays a dirty trick on Olive, and her horse is disqualified. Olive, with nowhere to turn, tells Popeye to do something. Popeye decides to enter Swee'Pea horse.

videos.title: The Great Speckled Whale
videos.overview: Sailing on the "S.S. Popeye," Popeye and Olive are out to photograph "The Great Speckled Whale."

videos.title: Popierre the Musketeer
videos.overview: While Popierre the Musketeer collects weapons because of a new law, Olivella, the Queen's handmaid, comes along with a jeweled crown to be given to the King.

videos.title: Reptile Ranch
videos.overview: Olive places a help-wanted sign, both Popeye and Bluto answer and compete with one another to become her handyman.

videos.title: Mission Improbable
videos.overview: Olive Oyl and Alice the Goon are sent on a top secret mission by Colonel Crumb, much to Sergeant Blasts disappointment.

videos.title: So Who's Watching the Bird Watchers?
videos.overview: Olive tries to get Popeye and Bluto interested in bird watching.

videos.title: Computer Chaos
videos.overview: Private Olive Oyl gets into trouble when introduced to a computerized robot.

videos.title: Chilly Con Caveman
videos.overview: Bluto discovers white powder (snow) that cools off the cave him, Popeye and Olive are in.

videos.title: Here Today, Goon Tomorrow
videos.overview: When Sergeant Blast tells Privates Oyl and Goon to "get lost", they take it literally and get lost in the desert. To keep herself out of trouble, the Sergeant has to go find Olive and Alice because Colonel Crumb wants to see them by a certain time.

videos.title: Come Back, Little Stegosaurus
videos.overview: Olive's cat Fluffy runs off, and Popeye and Bluto set out to find him.

videos.title: Troop Therapy
videos.overview: Colonel Crumb instructs Sergeant Blast to schedule a training drill for Private Oyl and Goon, much to Sergeant Blast's displeasure the girls come through with flying colors.

videos.title: Olive's Devastating Decorators
videos.overview: Olive thinks that her decorating chores will go much easier with the help of Popeye and Bluto. Much to her surprise the boys end up being no help at all.

videos.title: Goon Native
videos.overview: Sergeant Blast is stuck with Olive and Alice to go on beach maneuvers. Instead of taking it as serious army maneuvers, Olive and Alice think of it as a vacation. This leads them to some troubles, which make Sergeant Blast wish that she wasn't in the army with them.

videos.title: Cheap Skate Date
videos.overview: At a roller skating ring, Bluto is bothering Olive who is learning how to skate. As she starts to yell for help, Popeye rescues her from Bluto and now she can freely learn how to skate without falling all the time.

videos.title: Alice in Blunderland
videos.overview: While in the army, Olive and Alice as usual give a lot of trouble to Sergeant Bleast who really gets mad when she finds out that they were invited to go have lunch with the General, while she has to take care of a goat.

videos.title: Neanderthal Nuisance
videos.overview: Caveman Popeye visits Cavewoman Olive for a day of sunbathing in her backyard. Olive's pesky new neighbor, Caveman Bluto, will not leave them alone. Popeye tries several times to get rid of him.

videos.title: Wreck Room
videos.overview: Colonel Crumb makes Olive a Sergeant for one day, so that she and Sergeant Blast can finish the recreational room. Sergeant Blast is very surprised and very mad when Colonel Crumb informs her that Olive's bright colors on her side of the room are very good for the morale, and orders Blast to the same to her side.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Popeye
videos.overview: While passing through a park, where Popeye picked up some flowers for Olive (who had invited him for dinner) he gets sprayed with a shrinking potion. As Popeye got smaller his problems just started. When he finally arrives at Olive's house, dinner is over but he is still on time for dessert....strawberry shortcake.

videos.title: Private Secretaries
videos.overview: Privates Olive and Alice Go along with Sergeant Blast who were ordered by Colonel Crumb to do his paperwork. While Blast is trying to fix-up his office, Olive and Alice keep on messing it up. Colonel Crumb arrives and is very surprised to see that in the middle of all the mess, Olive and Alice had found his army yearbook.

videos.title: The First Resort
videos.overview: Both Popeye and Bluto decide to take a rest at Olive's restful resort. After a few "encounters" with Bluto, and after rescuing Olive from a falling down ceiling, Popeye decides to leave the restful resort because rest was the only thing he didn't do there.

videos.title: Goon Balloon
videos.overview: While doing the laundry, Alice took a balloon basket by mistake, and Olive, herself and Sergeant Blast end up taking a balloon ride. While enjoying the ride, Olive took some pictures with a camera that was inside the basket. On the ground Blast reported them to the Colonel who for her surprise was very happy with what had happen, because he wanted to test that camera and now he knows that it works perfectly.

videos.title: Vegetable Stew
videos.overview: Popeye and Bluto volunteer to go shopping, so that Olive can fix them something to eat. After the shopping is done, they return to Olive's cafe, but before eating Popeye has to go pick up flowers for the table. While doing this a bee-a-saurus attacks him and when Olive goes to help him she also gets trapped. With a little help from his spinach, Popeye rescues Olive only to find out that Wimpy had eaten all of the food.

videos.title: Tanks a Lot
videos.overview: Privates Olive, Alice and the rest of Sergeant Blast's army troop are doing field maneuvers. Left on their own, they discover a tank and impress Colonel Crumb with their driving skills.

videos.title: Winner Window Washer
videos.overview: Both Popeye and Bluto answer an ad for a job as window washers for Olive. Olive decides that she will hire the one who finishes doing the windows first. Bluto tries to stop Popeye from getting ahead of him, but Popeye comes out the winner.

videos.title: Rocky Rolls
videos.overview: After making a cake with blasting powder, it explodes and Sergeant Blast is really mad. She gets even madder when the Colonel invites Olive and Alice to go have dinner in town with him, and orders her to rearrange his rock garden with the pieces of Olive's cake.

videos.title: Hogwash at the Car Wash
videos.overview: Olive takes her car to be cleaned at Popeye's carwash. There Bluto starts to interfere with his work and Popeye puts an end to his interferences by putting him through the carwash.

videos.title: Snow Fooling
videos.overview: Colonel Crumb is going to Hawaii, but he can't get to his jeep, because of the snow. Sergeant Blast orders private Olive and Alice to clean up the snow (which they do). After the Colonel's departure, by a misunderstood order, Alice and Olive take the jeep and leave, leaving behind Sergeant Blast who is very mad.

videos.title: Bronto Beach
videos.overview: Popeye is teaching Olive how to fish, but Bluto keeps on interfering with them. When trouble starts, Bluto runs away, leaving behind Olive who is rescued by Popeye.

videos.title: Infink-try
videos.overview: While visiting Olive and Alice, Swee'Pea ignores the visiting hours and stays on the base without Olive's knowledge. While parachuting, Olive finds Swee'Pea inside the parachute. Everything is fine, until Swee'Pea gets into trouble and Olive has to rescue him. Instead of being angry with Olive for having Swee'Pea on base, Colonel Crumb thinks that they were excellently trained, because of the action he saw when Olive was rescuing Swee'Pea.

videos.title: The Midnight Ride of Popeye Revere
videos.overview: Popeye tells the story of "Popeye Revere" to his nephews.

videos.title: Goon Hollywood
videos.overview: Sergeant Blast is trying to fix up a film to show the troops. As it turns out, Olive and Alice screw up the film, but to the Sergeant's surprise, Colonel Crumb likes it and wants more like it. (With Olive and Alice as the stars of course!).

videos.title: Popeye Stumps Bluto
videos.overview: Olive promises to give a job to whoever is the best. It is competition between Popeye and Bluto. Bluto tries to stop Popeye who comes out the winner.

videos.title: Basic Train-ing
videos.overview: After doing a few mistakes, privates Olive Oyl and Alice Goon wreck a few buildings with a train. Colonel Crumb thinks that is wonderful because the buildings were coming down any way, and it also showed the trains rugged, construction.

videos.title: Up a Lizard River
videos.overview: Cavemen Popeye and Bluto compete to make the best camping site for Olive. The wilderness is scarier than expected and Popeye has to use spinach to save Olive from dinosaurs.

videos.title: Jeep Thrills
videos.overview: Private Olive and Alice are ready for inspection. Sergeant Blast finds their pet Jeep and drives herself crazy trying to catch it and bring it to the army pound.

videos.title: Olive's Moving Experience
videos.overview: Olive wants to move out to the beach and Popeye's moving service is at her disposal - until Bluto's moving company decides to help out. Popeye needs his spinach to help Olive save her furniture and other valuables from Bluto.
